findings.finding: The caller fallback reuses original FG FailureEvidence whose unavailable fields must be named in an enclosing TerminalEvidence. When no valid observer return exists, the new fallback carries its own missing_evidence list but no enclosing TerminalEvidence or explicit contextual binding of the old requirement.
static_boundary_reasoning: An observer handle may be acquired before full identity acquisition succeeds.
If identity acquisition fails and there is no valid observer return, caller fallback is the intended rejecting representation.
Its mandatory original identity_failure may contain unavailable owner identity, with original FG contextual requirements.
The fallback's terminal_evidence_digest can be null; neither fallback nor CallerAssessment contains the required enclosing terminal.
A same-named missing_evidence field in a different form does not itself specify how the original contextual obligation is fulfilled.

findings.safety_boundary: IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE and external no-return still reject; fail-closed disposition remains. The defect is incomplete traceable error representation.
findings.correction_need: Separately bind the responsible enclosing evidence role and unavailable-field propagation for primary and cleanup failures without a valid observer return. Preserve FG rules; do not fabricate observer evidence.
